snippet.title: Growing Pains Trailer (May 2014)
snippet.description:
Growing Pains on Steam - http://store.steampowered.com/app/291610/

Growing pains is a fast and furious platformer which gives the genre a shake up with psychedelic graphics, a thumping soundtrack and an ingenious twist that you've never seen before.

The "Vessel" which you control continually grows and expands leaving you in a permanent race to clear the area and escape before you get too big and find your butt wedged in a tight spot. Combine this with tight controls and levels crammed with devious traps and you've got a heart-pounding race guaranteed to leave you with sweaty palms and a sense of overwhelming satisfaction when you reach the goal.

http://www.smudgedcat.com/growingpains.htm
